parameters.formDescription: Submit a job description and your resume for an AI-powered fit analysis.

nodes.name: 2 · PDF Parser
nodes.notes: DETERMINISTIC: Extracts plain text from the uploaded resume PDF using n8n's built-in file extraction. No AI involved.

values.content:
You are a professional resume parser. Extract structured information from resume text and return ONLY valid JSON. Do not include any explanation or markdown.

Return this exact schema:
{
  "name": "string",
  "email": "string or null",
  "phone": "string or null",
  "skills": ["list of technical and soft skills"],
  "experience_years": number,
  "job_titles": ["previous job titles"],
  "education": ["degree and institution"],
  "certifications": ["list or empty array"],
  "summary": "2-3 sentence professional summary"
}

nodes.name: 3 · AI Extractor (LLM)
nodes.notes: AI STEP — Role: Extractor. Parses raw resume text into structured JSON fields (skills, experience, education). Low temperature for consistent extraction.

nodes.name: 3b · Parse Extractor JSON
nodes.notes: DETERMINISTIC: Cleans and validates the JSON returned by the AI extractor. Strips markdown code fences, throws on invalid JSON.

values.content:
You are an expert recruiter. Compare a job description to a candidate's resume and return ONLY valid JSON.

Return this exact schema:
{
  "overall_score": number (0-100),
  "skills_match_score": number (0-100),
  "experience_match_score": number (0-100),
  "education_match_score": number (0-100),
  "matched_skills": ["skills present in both JD and resume"],
  "missing_skills": ["skills required in JD but absent from resume"],
  "strengths": ["2-3 candidate strengths relevant to the JD"],
  "gaps": ["2-3 key gaps"],
  "recommendation": "one sentence recruiter verdict",
  "fit_category": "strong_fit | partial_fit | low_fit"
}

Scoring guide:
- 70-100: Strong fit — recommend for interview
- 40-69: Partial fit — recommend with conditions
- 0-39: Low fit — not suitable at this time

nodes.name: 4 · AI Fit Scorer (LLM)
nodes.notes: AI STEP — Role: Scorer + Analyst. Compares JD requirements against extracted resume data. Returns structured fit scores and reasoning.

nodes.name: 5 · Score Validator (Deterministic)
nodes.notes: DETERMINISTIC: Validates score is numeric 0-100. Enforces fit_category against thresholds (70+, 40-69, <40). This is deterministic rule enforcement — not AI.

nodes.name: 6 · Router (by Score Category)
nodes.notes: DETERMINISTIC: Routes execution based on fit_category string set by Score Validator. Three outputs: strong_fit → human approval, partial_fit → AI recommender, low_fit → auto reject.

parameters.subject: Your application — we'd like to review it further
parameters.message:
=

Application Received ✓

Dear {{ $json.candidate_name }},

Your application scored {{ $json.overall_score }}/100 — a strong fit for this role.

Your top matched skills: {{ $json.score_data.matched_skills.join(', ') }}

Recruiter note: {{ $json.score_data.recommendation }}

A recruiter will follow up within 2 business days.

nodes.name: 6a · Notify Candidate (Strong Fit)
nodes.notes: HUMAN-IN-LOOP: Sends notification email to candidate. Simultaneously sends an internal alert to recruiter for manual review and approval before proceeding.

nodes.name: 6b · AI Recommender (Partial Fit)
nodes.notes: AI STEP — Role: Career Coach / Recommender. Only triggers for partial fit. Generates personalized improvement suggestions for the candidate.

parameters.subject: Your application — feedback and next steps
parameters.message:
=

Application Feedback

Dear {{ $('5 · Score Validator (Deterministic)').item.json.candidate_name }},

Your application scored {{ $('5 · Score Validator (Deterministic)').item.json.overall_score }}/100. You show real potential, with some areas to develop before you'd be a strong match.

Your strengths: {{ $('5 · Score Validator (Deterministic)').item.json.score_data.strengths.join(', ') }}

Personalized improvement plan:

    {{ JSON.parse($json.message.content).recommendations.map(r => `
  • ${r.area}: ${r.action} — ${r.resources}
    • `).join('') }}

parameters.subject: Your application — update
parameters.message:
=

Dear {{ $json.candidate_name }},

Thank you for applying. After reviewing your application (score: {{ $json.overall_score }}/100), we don't feel it's the right match for this role at this time.

We encourage you to apply for other positions that may be a better fit.

Best regards,
The Recruitment Team

nodes.name: 6c · Auto-Reject Email (Low Fit)
nodes.notes: DETERMINISTIC: Triggered automatically for scores <40. No human review needed. Sends a polite rejection email.

nodes.name: Log to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: DETERMINISTIC: Appends every result to a Google Sheet for recruiter dashboard and audit trail.
